text: Waiting for the right moment? Rumi's lion has a question for you.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: In the Masnavi, the animals offer a lion a deal... one of them each day, if he stops hunting.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: He'd rather rely on his own effort. They say... relax.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Lay aside caution... trust is the better part.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: The lion concedes one point. True, he says... trust is the mainstay. But...
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Ye have feet... why then pretend ye are lame? Ye have hands... why then conceal your claws?
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: In essence... the Creator sets a ladder at your feet. Climb to the roof... step by step.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: And just waiting? He calls it sleeping on the road... among highwaymen.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: The twist? The lion takes their deal anyway. Then the hare, the weakest of them, makes a plan... and outwits him.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Trust was never the problem. Trust with folded hands is. Like dreaming of the right job... and sending zero applications.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: This morning, pick one thing you keep saying will work out... and take one step before noon. One email. One page. One call.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: What are you still waiting on? One word, in the comments.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Follow Awaaz... and climb one step today.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural
